verified_facts.text: The Grand Hotel Savoia dates back to the early 20th century.

verified_facts.text: For over a century the hotel has had a ringside seat in Cortina d'Ampezzo, gateway to the Dolomites.
verified_facts.excerpt: For over a century, Grand Hotel Savoia has enjoyed a ringside seat, offering the inside track to one of Italy’s most beautiful mountain destinations.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are inspired by the traditional mountain chalet, snug and wood-lined.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms are inspired by the traditional mountain chalet – snug and wood-lined with the sense of adventure just outside.

verified_facts.text: The refurbished rooms and suites are designed with a sense of contemporary luxury.

verified_facts.text: Rooms combine parquet flooring with luxurious fabrics and fittings, with views over the town and mountainscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: the warm elegance of parquet flooring is combined with luxurious fabrics and fittings, mixed with individual details and views out over the town and mountainscape

verified_facts.text: The hotel has rooms for family breaks, romantic getaways and outdoor adventures.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have a variety of rooms for all occasions – from family breaks to romantic getaways and outdoor adventures.

verified_facts.text: The 1224 Terrazza is an open-air lounge with views of Cortina and the Ampezzo Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 1224 Terrazza is the exclusive open-air lounge where you can regenerate after a day on the slopes, enjoying the breathtaking view of Cortina and the Ampezzo Valley

verified_facts.text: The 1224 Lounge Bar serves cocktails with a piano bar atmosphere.
verified_facts.excerpt: end at the 1224 Lounge Bar, where all the senses are tempted by refined cocktails and the rarefied atmosphere of the piano bar

verified_facts.text: The hotel's restaurant is the Savoy restaurant.
